newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas trade focused on next winter.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas trade focused on next winter.

text.p: Trade on the IPE natural gas contract was confined to the first quarter of next year, with the overall tone of the market softer.

A total of 75 lots changed hands in the first quarter. January shed 0.275 pence a therm (p/th) to trade at 17.5 p/th, while February shed 0.310 p/th to 17.5 p/th. March traded unchanged at 14.75 p/th.
"The market is generally softer across the board," said one dealer.
Prices on the OTC market also eased lower after modest gains on Monday.
